schema.name: English province/territory name matching GDP CSV GEO
schema.value: percentage share, 2 decimals in raw CSV; null only if original missing
schema.status: original STATUS; blank for all 156 selected values

statistics.definition: Each industry value is its current-price GDP share of the province/territory total economy.

footnotes.summary: Current price weights represent each industry share of the provincial/territorial total economy.
Current and chained dollars are in table 36-10-0711-01.
With the November 6, 2025 release, GDP by industry adopted NAICS Canada 2022 version 1.0.

limitations: The selected Mining, quarrying, and oil and gas extraction [21] includes activities beyond oil and gas extraction [211]; retain its exact definition.
All industries [T001] is 100%, useful as a total reference rather than an industry pattern map.

boundaries.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census Cartographic Boundary Files, PR - lpr_000b21s_e
boundaries.definition: Cartographic boundaries remove coastal water areas; same source metadata apply to official Esri REST and WMS services.
boundaries.join: PRUID or DGUID; PRENAME matches GDP GEO
limitations: Educational statistical mapping; not cadastral/legal/survey precision.
Raw source is detailed; display generalization may be needed.
Metadata endpoint repeatedly returned server configuration error, but the openly documented GeoJSON query returned HTTP 200 without bypass.

reading.energyUse: Independent factual paraphrase and link; no CER figure redistribution

excluded: No chained-dollar level, no GDP dollar back-calculation, no claim that NAICS21 means all natural resources or only oil/gas.

generalization.method: Douglas–Peucker in display coordinates; retained rings remain closed and holes use evenodd. Rings with bounding-box diagonal below 0.5 display pixels are omitted from the display only. Full original geography and original bounds retained; no area calculation; province-label anchors are editorial location guides, not facilities.
